rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something with enthusiasm or eagerness.

example.english: They enthusiastically helped me look for a job.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jit6 sam1 gam3 bong1 ngo5 wan2 gung1

rows.note: Use this when people eagerly volunteer or vie with one another to do something.

example.english: The students enthusiastically vied to perform on stage.
example.jyutping: di1 tung4 hok6 zaang1 zyu6 soeng5 toi1 biu2 jin2

rows.note: Use this especially for enthusiastic welcoming, support, applause, or other public reactions.

example.english: The audience enthusiastically applauded to welcome them.
example.traditional: 觀眾熱烈咁鼓掌歡迎佢哋。
example.jyutping: gun1 zung3 jit6 lit6 gam3 gu2 zoeng2 fun1 jing4 keoi5 dei6
